name: Four Corners Orientation CO 2026
information: Welcome to the first ever competition in Durango, Colorado!! All competitors must read the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FourCornersOrientationCO2026#79519-must-read-competitor-responsibilities) tab before registering. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjMwNTQ1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3465a772c598db53f398305da4947a0f7e0087c5/4-corner-orientation-v2.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjIyMzk3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--dfe755b5d9b4753f445fe75dc00b21dfc7aca250/RMC_CC.jpg) Even though on-the-spot registration is enabled, do not count on this! If the competition fills up, we won't be able to accept on-the-spot registrations, even if competitors do not show up. If you are able, we very much appreciate you registering in advance to save us time and effort, and save you some money! See the [OTS](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FourCornersOrientationCO2026#83053-on-the-spot-ots-registration) tab for more information. Live results, group assignments, and a more in-depth schedule can be found on the [Important Day-of Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FourCornersOrientationCO2026#79522-important-day-of-information) tab.
